technical.summary: Established uptrend with strong directional structure but overbought momentum across all RSI periods and declining volume confirmation limit swing entry probability.

fundamental.summary: AME shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 78 days present elevated risk.

sentiment.summary: No actionable sentiment signal; mixed congressional activity (small purchases offset by prior sale), neutral market fear/greed, and absent news data provide insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (267.84) indicates extreme market stress, with earnings 78 days away providing moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Established uptrend structure with ADX trending, price above 200-EMA, Ichimoku above cloud, and Supertrend bullish provides directional confirmation for swing entry near support.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought RSI across all periods (9/14/21), collapsing volume confirmation (OBV/AD flat, vol_ratio 0.51), zero fundamental conviction, extreme macro stress (VIX crisis, inverted yield curve), and earnings risk in 78 days create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows established uptrend with price above 200-EMA and Supertrend bullish, but overbought RSI across all periods and collapsing volume confirmation severely limit swing entry probability.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme macro stress (VIX crisis at 267.84, inverted yield curve) combined with earnings event 78 days away creates asymmetric downside risk that outweighs technical structure; overbought momentum likely to mean-revert.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding AME position with 62 existing Industrials positions (18% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing exposure reduce conviction further; skip new entry.
